---
name: Improvement
about: Suggest an enhancement, optimization, refinement, or other improvement to an existing feature or behavior.
title: '[IMPROVEMENT] '
labels: enhancement
---

## :sparkles: Summary

Provide a clear and concise summary of the proposed improvement.

## :mag: Background

Explain the current behavior, limitation, or opportunity for improvement.

Why is this change beneficial? What problem does it solve or what value does it add?

## :wrench: Proposed Changes

Describe the proposed implementation or approach.

Provide as much detail as possible, including examples, expected behavior, compatibility considerations, and interactions with existing features where applicable.

## :white_check_mark: Expected Benefits

Describe the expected outcome of this improvement.

Examples may include usability, performance, privacy, security, accessibility, maintainability, compatibility, or other measurable benefits.

## :memo: Additional Context

Add any other context, references, screenshots, benchmarks, related issues, or implementation notes that may help evaluate the proposal.
